checks.label: Reading right to left, you first apply the transformation represented by the matrix on the right, then the one on the left: in every run drawn, the flag passes through the right-hand card first, its ghost sits where that card alone sends it, and it ends where the product sends it

Matrix multiplication is not commutative in general: the shear and the quarter turn give one matrix in one order and a different one in the other, and side by side the two flags end in different places

Each entry of a product is a row of the left times a column of the right, pair by pair, added; for every pair of moves and for P and Q this matches running the right-hand matrix and then the left-hand one on every whole point near the origin, and screen 7 works each entry that way

Every worked number is right: AB = [1 −1; 1 0] and BA = [0 −1; 1 1]; B sends i to (0, 1) and j to (−1, 0); after both, i is on (1, 1); the shear sends j to (1, 1) and the turn sends (1, 1) to (−1, 1); MS = [−1 −1; 0 1] sends j to (−1, 1), SM = [−1 1; 0 1]; PQ = [4 8; 6 0], QP = [2 13; 4 2], matching entries give [2 4; 0 0]; P + Q = [3 5; 2 3], 2P = [4 2; 0 6], 2Q + P = [4 9; 4 3]; the top-left of AB is 1 × 0 + 1 × 1 = 1

Sizes have to fit: a product exists only when each row of the left is as long as each column of the right; D (2 by 2) times C (2 by 3) gives a 2 by 3, C times D cannot be worked out, and a 2 by 3 times a 3 by 2 gives a 2 by 2

Some pairs give the same either way: two turns, any card with Do nothing, and the mirror with the stretch; every move keeps the origin fixed, a mirror turns the flag over, and turns and shears keep its size

Each puzzle's answer comes from the rule (B then A for i, the shear first for BA, the first move on the right, rows times columns, doubling then adding, S then M for j, the sizes), and each slip offered is the one its hint names
Each puzzle offers three different answers, accepts only the right one, and draws every wrong one in the warning colour
Before Check, no puzzle shows its answer (no landing spot, no product, no pairing); after a right answer, it does
Every demonstration has finished arriving within its 3 to 4.5 s, none starting before the 0.35 s screen fade ends; every answer's motion, right or wrong, within 2.5 s
